lastChange.note: Version 53, updates (the owner, 7 Oct 2026: no paid code signing, "yes, per-user install and tracer after v1"): Settings has Updates, where GameSync says the version it runs, gets a newer one from GitHub once a day in the background and installs it only when you Restart to update, after its own release signature checks out (SettingsScreen #updates, #updates-latest, #updates-downloading, #updates-refused, #updates-offline); Home's top bar offers Restart to update while one is ready (LauncherScreen #update); Safety's Let learn mode ask for admin is tagged After v1.
